draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.36, the 34th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 5th of 36 at CB. He went 40th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2023, 23rd of 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 32 career games and 25 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (11 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 11 (98th percentile), passes defended 16 (96th percentile), season snap share 92.1% (94th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 92.1% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, above the norm.
